name: Kael
brief: A scarred relic-hunter who came to the abbey for what is sealed beneath it.

items.name: a guttering lantern
items.brief: A dented tin lantern whose flame will not hold still.

traits.name: Unsteady Lantern
traits.text: (gear) Its shifting light exposes seams and movement in deep shadow.

traits.name: Relic Hunter
traits.text: (edge) Kael knows how old sanctums conceal what matters.

traits.name: Marked by the Past
traits.text: (burden) Old scars make certain memories hard to face.
